name: Idol✩Complex!
source:
You play as Reina Maeda, an Idol trainee who has just been released from her company due to her being the least popular member of her group. Considering dropping being an idol, she stumbles upon a flyer for an audition for the new coming group, Misfit✩Dreams~. She ends up acing the audition, making her the fifth addition to the group. How will she get along with the other members? Will she blow it again? You decide!

[From [url=https://syntheotaku.itch.io/idolcomplex]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演偶像练习生Reina Maeda。因为是团体中人气最低的一员，她刚刚遭到公司解约。正考虑放弃偶像之路的她，偶然看到新组合Misfit✩Dreams~招募成员的试镜传单。她最终出色地通过了试镜，成为组合的第五名成员。她会如何与其他成员相处？这次还会搞砸吗？一切由你决定！

[摘自[url=https://syntheotaku.itch.io/idolcomplex]Itch.io[/url]]
